prerequisitesOutsideThisImage.item: PLATFORM POLICY CARRIER for relay-mode Linux (blocks any admin ANCHOR, not this cutover)
prerequisitesOutsideThisImage.what: 40e8ba71 selects NO mirror by default (the 4 DigitalOcean /platform-policy mirrors e83515fc used are gone) and its carrier wrapper reads ENCLAVE_PLATFORM_HOST_POLICY_CARRIERS from process.env, but gsup's legacy (relay-mode) branch builds supEnv from the baked flavor-env.json + the fw_cfg host-wallet policy env only (metal/guest/gsup.mjs supEnv) and the launcher forwards no carrier field (metal/enclave-metal.mjs fw object: hostAdmission, leaseGas, ownerNomination). Only the measured DIRECT guest has the bound platformPolicyCarriers member (metal/guest/measured-control.mjs CARRIERS_ENV). So once the administrator anchors a policy, this image cannot fetch it and refuses itself after the grace. Before any anchor: either a reviewed relay-mode carrier pass-through (launcher fw_cfg platformPolicyCarriers validated like measured-control directPolicyCarriers -> gsup legacy supEnv ENCLAVE_PLATFORM_HOST_POLICY_CARRIERS; a new image + measurement), or Linux control moves to the measured direct image. Unanchored (today's recorded state) both bundles admit as 'not activated'.

the KEPT plan's leaseGas.relays is the single EU relay https://134.209.248.172 (DigitalOcean; ROOT-STAGING-STATE.txt: intentional temporary topology). This image adds optional leaseGas.pinnedRelays (host-local relay over 10.0.2.2, payee+operator bound, policy-judged) and service-index relay discovery; using them is a separate config change (new fw_cfg value, no new measurement) after a host-local lease relay role exists on metal0.
